_comment: Each topic is one search against https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies. Parameters use the API's Essie expression syntax (OR, AND, quoted phrases). Add a topic, push, and the next weekly run picks it up.

params.query.intr: "tumor infiltrating lymphocytes" OR "tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes" OR "tumor infiltrating lymphocyte" OR "tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte" OR lifileucel OR "TIL therapy"
"TCR-T" OR "TCR-engineered" OR "T cell receptor engineered" OR "neoantigen-specific T cells"
params.query.cond: cancer OR tumor OR carcinoma OR melanoma OR neoplasm

geo._comment: Weekly NCBI GEO watch: new human GEO series matching these Entrez queries are listed on the Datasets page. Set the NCBI_EMAIL repo secret so NCBI can contact you if a query misbehaves.

queries.label: TIL / adoptive transfer, single-cell or spatial
queries.term: ("tumor infiltrating lymphocytes" OR "tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes" OR "adoptive cell therapy" OR "adoptive cell transfer") AND ("single cell" OR "single-cell" OR spatial OR TCR)

queries.label: Melanoma immunotherapy, spatial
queries.term: (melanoma) AND (immunotherapy OR "checkpoint" OR "PD-1") AND (spatial OR Visium OR Xenium OR CosMx OR GeoMx OR "imaging mass cytometry")

queries.label: Stem-like CD8 T cells in tumors
queries.term: (TCF7 OR "stem-like" OR "progenitor exhausted") AND ("CD8") AND (tumor OR cancer) AND ("single cell" OR "single-cell")
